meta.title: LOCKIN — Focus & accountability sessions
meta.description: Set a task goal, run a timed session, block unrelated sites, and review your session history. Camera video is processed on your device and never uploaded.

landing.headline: Set a goal. Lock out distractions. Review your session.
landing.sub: LOCKIN helps you turn study intentions into structured work sessions — with a task goal, a timer, a website allowlist, and optional camera reminders.
landing.feature1Body: Write a specific task and choose a duration. Pauses never count as session time.
landing.feature2Body: The Chrome extension blocks sites outside your list during a session. Overrides are always deliberate and recorded.
landing.feature3Body: Face and phone detection runs in your browser. Video never leaves your device.
landing.feature4Body: Compare your plan with what happened, and delete records whenever you like.
landing.disclaimer: LOCKIN records session time, not proof of focus or productivity.
